facts.fact: Eden 在 Oliver 床上醒来，翻身就看见几英寸外的睡脸。
facts.anchor: When I roll over and find Oliver’s sleeping face inches away from me

facts.fact: 她摸到辫子才想起昨晚：是 Oliver 给她编的。
facts.anchor: my hair is in a braid

facts.fact: 她的账：下周有三份作业，一想他就学不进去。
facts.anchor: I’ve got three assignments due next week

facts.fact: 她的三连：不能让他失望、不能放手、但必须放手。
facts.anchor: I can’t let him down. I can’t let him go. But I have to.

facts.fact: 被抓包偷溜后，Oliver 提议做早餐，她犹豫后说想留下。
弟弟 Jake 视频乱入，听见男声便断定「Eden 有男友」并要告诉妈妈。
facts.anchor: Eden has a boyfriend! Just wait until I tell Mum.

facts.fact: 她交底：高中后再没带男孩回家过。
facts.anchor: I haven’t brought a boy home since high school.
